name: ai-completion

steps.name: compose the prompt
steps.note: A prompt is data, not a glued string. AI/Completions declares Messages as ChatCompletionsRequestMessageViewModel[], so the step hands it an array of that very type - no serialising, no shape to drift.

steps.name: ask the model
steps.note: The built-in answers with string[] - one serialised chunk per step of the generation, not one finished text. It also raises a boundary event named Event_Start_Sending on every chunk; the name is fixed inside the engine, and when no such event exists the engine logs a warning and carries on.

steps.name: join the chunks
steps.note: The chunks arrive in order, and joining them is the caller's job. Reading choices[0].delta.content keeps the model's own wire shape, so the same code works whether the answer came in two pieces or two hundred.

documentation: Call the model through the engine's own AI function, then join the chunks it answers with.

success.title: ANSWERED
